title: Distributed representations of behaviour-derived object dimensions in the human visual system
goal: Reproduce the original image-wise object-dimension encoding and category-versus-dimension variance-partitioning results in all three THINGS-fMRI participants from the released single-trial response tables, preserving source trial/voxel identities, participant-specific maps, original transformations and indispensable comparisons. Evaluate Figure 2 prediction improvement as a named empirical component on the original source task; higher encoding accuracy alone does not establish the Figure 6 attribution result or complete-family success. Retain source-supported shape companions with their unresolved recipe and report new image-family/category evaluation separately as an extension.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The original enrolled single-trial empirical family includes full object-dimension encoding and category-versus-dimension variance attribution in three source participants. Preserve complete participant-specific encoding and attribution maps, source ROI summaries and indispensable comparisons. Figure 2 prediction is a valid nested empirical component, not an unrelated proxy. Raw-fMRI preprocessing, the separate time-series/HRF route and automatic every-figure obligations remain outside this scope.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained source work: within_family_empirical_prediction_component: Preserve Figure 2 full-embedding response prediction, source fold-wise signed Pearson maps, original permutation companion and noise-ceiling convention as a meaningful named result and improvement route. Prediction gain alone cannot establish the attribution finding or complete-family success.
enrolled_empirical_attribution_result: Preserve the distinct Figure 6 joint, unique-dimension, unique-category and shared residualized-response attribution maps and original ROI summaries. These remain enrolled findings, not optional substitutes for an encoding score. Their normalization and selected-feature definitions differ from full-embedding prediction.
source_companion_unresolved: Retain the published exploratory shape comparison and source-grounded category/face/body companions with their actual roles. Exact shape descriptors, supplement recipe and applicability of optional code branches remain unresolved; generic descriptors or all available flags cannot replace source authentication.
prospective_extension: New image-family/category holdouts, nested regularization, train-only normalization or altered populations remain explicitly declared candidate/prospective comparisons rather than silently replacing original source reproduction.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful retained implementations with their declared coverage. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

retained_secondary_improvement.improvement_loop: Blocked pending source baseline recovery. Once admitted, use only original training-fold data and internal training-fold validation for iteration; preserve original outer session folds for the frozen comparison.

retained_secondary_improvement.final_evaluation: Replay frozen candidate and source author method on all original 12 sessions for each of the three participants; report paired source-metric changes plus all source scope restrictions.
retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: Keep published source score, reproduced author baseline, and any independently source-verified current SOTA separate. Reproduction is calibration only.

primary_source_limits: Authentic participant, repeated-trial, image, row/session, voxel and ROI identities and source masks remain unresolved. Unshuffled twelve-fold row partitions require verified correspondence before being treated as original leave-one-session-out folds.

Preserve full 66-dimensional encoding separately from the category-AUC-selected attribution subset. Preserve source global feature standardization, intercept OLS, secondary-object category unions, global feature/response residualization and source clipping/squaring conventions; ordinary same-target predictive commonality is a different estimand.

Per-fold signed Pearson and arithmetic fold means, publication noise-ceiling-corrected maps and ROI attribution outputs are not interchangeable. Source numerical maps, Figure 2 conversion, meaningful aggregation and reproduction/improvement criteria remain unqualified; no new across-voxel/participant scalar is selected.

The categorical dimension-versus-category claim is a genuine scientific statement but does not compute the required participant maps. A scorer on supplied prediction archives does not verify model fitting, authorized analysis or the complete encoding/attribution result. Schema coverage and actual native/source verification are separate gaps.

The shape comparison is identified in Supplementary Figure 6/Methods 2, but exact descriptors and implementation are not authenticated. Optional face/body source flags do not establish universally required published branches.

Direct primary-paper evidence inspected here is the retained abstract/opening excerpt, while Figure 2/6 Methods mapping is attributed to the existing reviewed reference report. Pinned author code excerpts were directly inspected. Rendered-evidence hashes are not upstream source-file or complete-paper hashes.

No explicit Figure-2-only replacement authority was found in the bounded inspected records. Preserve the enrolled family and named component; selecting Figure 2 as sole primary would be a new scope choice. Keep full-family/component bindings unavailable if their relationship cannot be represented faithfully.

Three participants do not establish broad participant generalization; voxels and folds are not independent people. Stronger significance or a favorable participant/voxel subset does not establish same-result improvement.
